title.en: MALACANANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES AN ORDER PLACING THE FILM DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL OF THE PHILIPPINES UNDER THE OVERSIGHT OF THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION

text.en:
The Film Development Council of the Philippines is placed under the
oversight of the Department of Education.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 20th day of October in the year of Our Lord, Two
Thousand and Nine.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
PaMA Hologram * 51137
